text: This report recognizes the success of the recent lighting revitalization of the Princes' Gates Arch initiated and coordinated by the Capital Works Division at Exhibition Place, in collaboration with Rogul Electric and Toronto Light Works. Toronto Illuminating Engineers Society recently announced that this project won the 2026 Illumination Section Award for Outdoor Lighting Design.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (June 4, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
